summary.zh: 在 DSH 进程内直接运行 magpie 的供应商插件：继承已装的插件与已登录账号，把每个供应商注册成一条模型路由。桌面用 magpie 原版界面；手机是原生面板——四个原生页签、平台卡片、额度窗口、用量统计、插件商店一键安装、每日签到，输入框上方还有额度条与每回合消耗脚注。
summary.en: Runs magpie's vendor-plugin ecosystem inside DSH: inherits installed plugins and signed-in accounts, and registers every provider as a model route. Desktop uses the original magpie UI; mobile gets a native panel with four native tabs, provider cards, quota windows, usage stats, one-click store installs, daily check-in, plus a quota strip above the composer and a per-turn usage footnote.
